description: Hypochlorite feed paced from the well flow; contact time for 4-log virus treatment; daily compliance grab sample of the residual (40 CFR 141.403(b)(3)(i)(B))
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Public health: under-disinfected water reaches homes within hours. A failure to maintain 4-log treatment that is not corrected within 4 hours is a treatment technique violation (141.404(c)) and must be reported to the state by the end of the next business day (141.405(a)(1)). RPO 24 h matches the daily residual log
manual_workaround: Run the hypochlorite pump in HAND at the panel with the stroke set from the written dose table; grab samples every 4 hours until the residual is restored; isolate the panel from the portal
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-operator (single point of failure); relief operator on days off; well house

description: Well pumps; ground storage tank; high-service pumps; hydropneumatic tank pressure in the distribution system
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The 50,000-gallon tank holds about one day of average demand, but pressure loss can force a precautionary boil water notice. RPO is the last approved PLC program and setpoints; the target is a monthly and after-change backup (not supported today: the integrator holds the only current copy)
manual_workaround: Run wells and high-service pumps in HAND at the panel; portable generator on the transfer switch during power loss
dependent_third_parties: Controls integrator (program copy); electric utility; generator fuel supplier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-operator (single point of failure); well house

description: Portal view of HMI screens and setpoint changes from the phone; alarm dialer calls for low residual, low level, low pressure, power failure, and door alarm
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without remote view the owner must visit the well house twice a day; the dialer runs on its own cellular line and does not depend on the portal. RPO 24 h is the portal's own process history
manual_workaround: Two site visits a day; rely on the alarm dialer; relief operator on call
dependent_third_parties: Remote access portal vendor; cellular carrier

description: Public notices (Tier 1 within 24 hours, 40 CFR 141.202(b)); customer calls; automated email and text notices from the billing SaaS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A Tier 1 notice must reach all persons served within 24 hours of learning of the situation. RPO 720 h is a monthly offline export of the customer contact list (not supported today: the list exists only in the billing SaaS)
manual_workaround: Hand delivery and posting at the subdivision entrance and mailbox clusters (138 homes, about 3 hours on foot and by truck); local radio for broad notice
dependent_third_parties: Billing SaaS vendor; primacy agency (consultation); local broadcast media

description: Monthly bills; payments through the processor's hosted page; monthly operating report and results to the state within the first 10 days after the month (40 CFR 141.31(a))
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $15,000 billed a month; billing can slip a few days. The monthly report deadline sets the MTD at 10 days
manual_workaround: Bill late with a cover note; file the monthly report from the paper log and lab portal
dependent_third_parties: Billing SaaS vendor; payment processor; certified laboratory; state reporting portal
